quarterly_data.signal: Wiwynn held the grand opening of its Socorro (El Paso), Texas manufacturing facility, equipped for server manufacturing and rack integration with complete production and testing capabilities for both air-cooled and liquid-cooled racks. The first building (about 393,000 square feet) kicked off in 2025, began shipments by the end of that year and is now entering mass production; the second building (approximately 476,000 square feet) is expected to begin production in the second quarter of 2027; the overall campus plan is expected to exceed 1.7 million square feet of total building area over the long term.
